search_scope.source_policy: Primary paper pages/PDFs were preferred. arXiv-only works are labeled preprints; publication status was not inferred when not verified.
search_scope.search_limit: A bounded novelty audit cannot prove global absence. The conclusion means no substantive coverage was located in the preregistered neighbor clusters by the cutoff date.

GRAM_role_specificity.reason: No located work defines the same native lexical token's GRAM-specific link-anchor, collaborative-attribute, and decoder-symbol roles as one falsifiable echo mechanism.

span_factorized_attribution.reason: GRAM reports only aggregate removal of information linking; no located work preserves the multi-passage layout while separately attributing item-anchor IDs, similar-item IDs, and metadata to the gold lexical path.

intervention_room.reason: Copy mechanisms, role/segment embeddings, contextual token composition, token weighting, and identifier redesign are prior art. Remaining room is only a target-free GRAM-specific intervention justified by confirmed role-level harm.

allowed_claims: Search-bounded evidence that GRAM-native lexical linking roles have not been jointly audited with position-preserving span counterfactuals.
If F0-D passes, a mechanism claim that harmful identifier-span contribution can coexist with helpful fine metadata on frozen GRAM checkpoints.
If later interventions pass, a recommendation-specific target-free role-disambiguation mechanism evaluated against matched controls.
forbidden_claims: First discovery of copy bias, lexical-overlap bias, repetition bias, popularity bias, token imbalance, or history bias.
First use of role embeddings, segment embeddings, counterfactual masking, contextual token embeddings, token weighting, or identifier redesign.
Fine passages or information linking are generally harmful.
A pathological echo exists merely because a recommended item resembles or repeats history.
Absolute novelty beyond the bounded search scope.

strongest_counterargument.claim: The repeated lexical IDs may be the intended semantic alignment/copy pathway that makes GRAM work, not an interference mechanism.
strongest_counterargument.required_rebuttal: F0-D must show raw harm from removing identifier spans on tail misses, superiority to deterministic token-count-matched metadata masks, positive residual metadata contribution, and a larger adjusted effect on tail misses than tail hits on both datasets. Otherwise LEI stops.

sources.evidence: Defines semantic-to-lexical translation, information linking, collaborative verbalization, and aggregate w/o-linking ablation.
Dynamic lexical identifier learning and collision-free inference.
Set-based lexical identifiers combined with sequential identifiers and simultaneous decoding.
Decomposed pretrained/collaborative token embeddings and contextual token composition.
Context-aware action tokenization and set permutation regularization.
Differentiable semantic indexing aligned with recommendation loss.
Information-gain and frequency weighting for output Semantic-ID tokens.
Token-level optimization diagnosis and popularity debiasing.
Masked history reconstruction with entropy policy and curriculum.
In-text reasoning and context pruning for generative recommendation.
Explicit repeat/explore modeling in sequential recommendation.
Generic neural copying from source to output.
Native-vocabulary structured Term IDs and identifier grounding.
